messages:
deploy-bot: auto-rollback kicked off for rollout v6.0.1 -> trigger: 5xx spike (>2% sustained over 7m). scheduling rollback to v6.0.0 and starting traffic reassign. :warning:
ian: stop the full rollback. FinanceCorp EU is seeing 500s but only for their tenant namespace; they asked we keep their canary so SRE can capture full payloads.
zoe: +1. prefer targeted suppression: pin FinanceCorp production routes to v6.0.0, keep tenant-canary on v6.0.1 at 6% for 2h, increase trace sampling and preserve logs.
ops-oncall: rollback job 1744506789 is 40% complete. queued actions: drain hosts in eu-west-2 and change LB weights. need a manual cancel to stop remaining operations.
deploy-bot: rollback job paused; awaiting human approval to suppress. suppression requires approver identity and reason.
paloma: I approve targeted suppression for FinanceCorp. ops-oncall please run: `deployctl cancel 1744506789` and `deployctl pin --tenant financecorp-eu --version v6.0.0 --reason "tenant debug window"` and `deployctl tenant-canary --tenant financecorp-eu --version v6.0.1 --percent 6`.
ops-oncall: executing now: `deployctl cancel 1744506789` -> success, `deployctl pin --tenant financecorp-eu --version v6.0.0 --reason "tenant requested debug window"` -> success (audit pin-4e2d), `deployctl tenant-canary --tenant financecorp-eu --version v6.0.1 --percent 6` -> success. suppression window set for 2 hours; auto-rollback re-enable scheduled at 1744513989 unless extended.
support-raj: sending short customer note: "We're investigating intermittent 5xx for a subset of requests. Your traffic will remain stable and we will capture traces; expect an update within 4 hours." cc SRE.
ian: ML/infra tasks: snapshot KV `kv-snap-174450`, bump trace sampling to 100% for financecorp-eu for 1h, enable model debug headers, tag logs `financecorp-canary-174450`. create INC-2024-4520 and assign eng-runtime + eng-ml.
zoe: initial trace peek shows decoder tail latency on a single host group and higher KV miss ratio. running focused repro against canary hosts now. if we confirm a model artifact regression, plan model-binary revert on canary hosts first instead of full infra rollback.
ops-oncall: retention and tags applied, KV snapshot stored. monitoring suppression window and will re-enable auto-rollback if cleared at expiry.
paloma: good coordination. if we need to flip global traffic later we will follow rollback runbook and notify stakeholders before action. keep updates in this thread. :white_check_mark:
